assets.title: Field Notes notebook and writing tools
assets.provenance: Rendered by Amy and supplied as PNG plates with alpha: a closed leather Field Notes cover lettered Tanzania, 2026 (front, back, spine, fore edge and two three-quarter angles) and one sheet of four pens and pencils. Claude cut the four tools apart on the alpha channel already present in the sheet, trimmed each plate to its alpha bounding box, resized and re-encoded to WebP. No repainting, recolouring or generated detail. Full resolution plates kept in assets/references/notebook.

assets.title: The field notebook opening
assets.provenance: Rendered by Amy: 1764x1176, 24 fps, 4.04 s, h264 on black with a warm glow, no alpha channel. Claude trimmed it to frames 6 to 78, the part that reads as the book opening, set the speed to 1.6x, scaled to 880 px wide and re-encoded at CRF 30. No frames were generated or interpolated. Played screen blended over a near black layer, which drops the black background and keeps the glow.

assets.title: Mazingira Mpya
assets.provenance: Supplied by Amy as a 48 kHz 16 bit stereo WAV master, 193.28 s, integrated loudness -16.1 LUFS. Claude cut a seamless loop from it: the source fades out from about 187 s, so the body 5 s to 186 s was taken and its tail cross faded over 3 s back into 2 s to 5 s using a constant power curve, then normalised to -20 LUFS with a -1.5 dBTP ceiling and encoded to AAC at 96 kbps. Loop is 181 s; measured level across the loop join differs by 1.8 dB.
